summary: Costamare Bulkers Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 results press release and financial report. Q3 net income was $16.6 million ($0.68 per share) with adjusted net income of $12.4 million ($0.51 per share); nine-month net income $31.7 million ($1.31 per share). The release cites $141.7 million cash, $358.2 million total liquidity, no significant loan maturities until Q4 2031 post-refinancing, and fleet of 29 owned and 32 chartered-in vessels. It also notes the Q3 sale of the 2009-built Supramax Bermondi at a roughly $2.5 million gain — an ordinary asset disposal, not a corporate special situation.
